chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad and others from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr who said:

Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) said: The optional prayer on the day of Friday is six rak'at in the early morning, and six rak'at in the middle of the day, and two rak'at when the sun declines. Then pray the Obligatory prayer and pray six rak'at after it.

key_terms.إِذَا زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ: When the sun declines (time of Dhuhr)

ai.seo_question: What is the prescribed number and timing of voluntary prayers on Friday according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Rida (AS) details the specific structure of Friday Nafl prayers, emphasizing the Sunnah of multiplying acts of worship on this blessed day. The sequence highlights the spiritual preparation before the obligatory Dhuhr prayer and the continued devotion after it, reflecting the Shia emphasis on augmenting the five daily prayers with recommended acts to increase reward and spiritual presence.

en.hubeali: Ali, from Muhammad, and someone else, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr who said,

‘Abu Al-Hassanasws said: The optional Salāt on the day of Friday is of six Rak’at early morning, and six Rak’at in the middle of the day, and two Rak’at when the sun (starts to) decline. Then pray the Obligatory Salāt and pray six Rak’at after it’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Muhammad and others have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr who has said the following: “

Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Optional Salah (prayer) on Friday is six Rak‘at very early, six Rak‘at in midday, two Rak‘at at Zawal (declining of the sun toward the west at noontime), then perform obligatory Salah (prayer), then perform six Rak‘at thereafter.”’
